SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
( "t0"."unit_price" * :f1_rate ) AS "adjusted"
 FROM "main"."read_item" AS "t0"
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
( ( "t0"."unit_price" * :f2_rate ) - :f1_rate ) AS "discounted",
( "t0"."unit_price" * :f2_rate ) AS "adjusted"
 FROM "main"."read_item" AS "t0"
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

SELECT ( "t0"."unit_price" * :f1_rate ) AS first,
( "t0"."unit_price" * :f1_rate ) AS second
 FROM "main"."read_item" AS "t0"
WHERE (( "t0"."unit_price" * :f1_rate ) > :minimum)
ORDER BY ( "t0"."unit_price" * :f1_rate ),"t0"."id"

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
( "t0"."unit_price" * :f1_rate ) AS "adjusted"
 FROM "main"."read_item" AS "t0"
WHERE ("t0"."unit_price" > :rate)
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

SELECT ( "t0"."unit_price" * :__f1_rate ) AS "adjusted"
 FROM "main"."read_item" AS "t0"
WHERE ("t0"."unit_price" > :f1_rate)
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
( ( "t0"."unit_price" * :f1_rate ) * "t0"."qty" ) AS "total"
 FROM "main"."read_item" AS "t0"
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
( "t0"."unit_price" * ( "t1"."conversion_factor" * :f1_rate ) ) AS "converted",
( "t0"."unit_price" * ( "t1"."conversion_factor" * :f1_rate ) ) AS "converted_alias"
 FROM "main"."read_item" AS "t0"
       LEFT JOIN "main"."read_currency" AS "t1" ON (("t0"."currency_id")="t1"."id")
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
( "t1"."conversion_factor" * :f1_rate ) AS first,
( "t2"."conversion_factor" * :f2_rate ) AS second
 FROM "main"."read_item" AS "t0"
       LEFT JOIN "main"."read_currency" AS "t1" ON (("t0"."currency_id")="t1"."id")
       LEFT JOIN "main"."read_currency" AS "t2" ON (("t0"."other_currency_id")="t2"."id")
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

SELECT ( "t0"."unit_price" * :f1_rate ) AS "adjusted",
( "t1"."conversion_factor" * :f3_rate ) AS "_currency_id_adjusted",
( ( "t0"."unit_price" * :f1_rate ) - :f2_rate ) AS "discounted"
 FROM "main"."read_item" AS "t0"
       LEFT JOIN "main"."read_currency" AS "t1" ON (("t0"."currency_id")="t1"."id")
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
( CASE WHEN "t0"."id" IN (:f1_ids0,:f1_ids1)  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS "selected",
( CASE WHEN "t0"."id" IN ()  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS "empty_selection"
 FROM "main"."read_item" AS "t0"
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
( :f1_text ) AS "literal"
 FROM "main"."read_item" AS "t0"
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id",
( "t0"."unit_price" + :f1_offset ) AS "kwargs"
 FROM "main"."read_item" AS "t0"
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

SELECT ( '' ) AS "env_value"

SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id"
 FROM "main"."read_item" AS "t0"
WHERE (( "t0"."unit_price" * :f1_rate ) >= :min)
ORDER BY "t0"."id"

SELECT "t0"."qty" AS "qty",
SUM(( "t0"."unit_price" * :f1_rate )) AS amount
 FROM "main"."read_item" AS "t0"
GROUP BY "t0"."qty"
HAVING SUM(( "t0"."unit_price" * :f1_rate ))>:min
ORDER BY "t0"."qty"

SELECT DISTINCT ( "t0"."unit_price" * :f1_rate ) AS "adjusted"
 FROM "main"."read_item" AS "t0"
ORDER BY ( "t0"."unit_price" * :f1_rate )

SELECT "t0"."stored_code" AS "code",
"t0"."seq" AS "seq",
( '[' ||  '"' ||  "t0"."stored_code" || '"'  ||', '||"t0"."seq" || ']'  ) AS "pkey"
 FROM "main"."read_composite" AS "t0"
ORDER BY "t0"."seq"

SELECT ( '[' ||  '"' ||  "t0"."stored_code" || '"'  ||', '||"t0"."seq" || ']'  ) AS "key"
 FROM "main"."read_composite" AS "t0"
WHERE (( '[' ||  '"' ||  "t0"."stored_code" || '"'  ||', '||"t0"."seq" || ']'  )=:key)
